name: Hilton Honors American Express Card

emergencyMedical.notes: No emergency medical or evacuation benefit on this no-annual-fee card.

rentalCarInsurance.notes: Car Rental Loss and Damage Insurance applies as secondary coverage. Must decline rental company's CDW. Coverage amount subject to Amex benefit terms.

rewards.travelRate: 7x at hotels and resorts in the Hilton portfolio

pointValue.transferPartners: 0.4–0.6¢ per Hilton Honors point; best redeemed for Hilton hotel stays

travelPerks: No annual fee — zero cost to hold
7x Hilton Honors points on Hilton hotel stays
5x points at US restaurants, supermarkets, and gas stations
Secondary rental car collision damage waiver
Points don't expire as long as account is open
bestFor: Occasional Hilton guests who want to earn hotel points with no annual fee and enjoy Silver Elite status perks without any cost
